author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the trailer for Warframe: Tau, Warframe's next major narrative chapter. Reach beyond the bounds of the Origin System and venture into a new Star Chart, the Tau System. Once a paradise built by the Sentients, Tau has been lost to war and ruin. Nowhere is this felt more keenly than on the black rain-soaked streets of Fornax, a colossal Sentient ring city. Here, the devastating downpour and its maddening influence run in rivulets from the heights of the Hunra's gambling dens, through the Docks, and into the most desperate Slums — where the residents have turned to the mind-altering Bloom in search of escape.
There, Albrecht Entrati awaits the arrival of the Tenno after conscripting the inner monologuing and noir-inspired Warframe, Brysko, to infiltrate the Hunra's criminal underworld — a final gamble to avert Fornax falling to those with nothing to lose. Get ready to risk it all. 
Warframe: Tau arrives later this year.

author: IGN
description:
College Football 27 reviewed by Will Borger on PlayStation 5, also available on Xbox Series X.

College Football 27’s excellent gameplay, largely smart on-field additions, and best-in-class presentation make this a junior season worth suiting up for. Dynasty and Road to Glory’s additions are welcome, but while both modes are better for having them, they also make me feel like I am never doing much beyond living inside of a spreadsheet when off the field. I wish College Football 27 had more space for on-campus life, and some of the monetization stuff is… gross. But what’s here, especially on the field, is still quite good. This season ain’t gonna knock anybody’s socks off. This was a good team last year, and it’s a good team this year. Just be prepared to worship the Evil God of Numbers a bit more than usual. I guess you either die a hero, or live long enough to operate a spreadsheet.

#ign #gaming #CollegeFootball27
title: College Football 27 Review

description:
The Nintendo Switch 2 is officially in its sophomore year and showing no signs of slowing down. Following major first-party launches like Pokemon Pokopia and Star Fox, the hybrid console is preparing for a massive wave of new releases. From highly anticipated spin-offs like Splatoon Raiders to legendary ports like Elden Ring: Tarnished Edition and Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Volume 2, we break down more than 40 games coming to the platform before the end of the year.

NVC's Logan Plant goes over upcoming Nintendo Switch 2 games in 2026, including highly anticipated titles like Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave, Final Fantasy XIV Online: A Realm Reborn, and the return of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. Whether you are looking for physics-based multiplayer fun in Heave Ho 2, massive open-world RPGs like Metaphor: ReFantazio, or action-packed franchises like Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, this video tracks major upcoming Switch 2 game launches, indie hits, and enhanced editions
title: The Biggest Nintendo Switch 2 Games Still Coming in 2026 (Summer Update)
